column1: 4.5.12 HB Jammer. For Shakti system, HB Jammer's are to be mounted at 45
degrees offset w.r.t Fore-Aft Axis (Standby Position to alleviate the field of View
obstructions due to Navigation Radars). HB Jammer (STBD) should be oriented towards
forward side while HB Jammer (Port) should be oriented towards the aft side.
